subject.title: Add unread_count and read state for chats/messages

question: Should imsg accept `unread_count`, inbound `is_read`/`date_read`, and `unread_only` as stable CLI/RPC output surface?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but these field names and filter semantics become public JSON/RPC contract once released, so automation should not choose the product/API direction alone.

options.title: Approve after proof
options.body: Accept the additive schema once the contributor adds redacted live history and RPC output proof, then merge through normal checks.

options.title: Request schema changes
options.body: Ask for renamed, narrowed, or differently-scoped fields before making the API public.

options.title: Defer core output
options.body: Keep read-state derivation downstream if maintainers do not want this in stable imsg JSON/RPC output.

recommendation.title: Approve after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the additive schema once the contributor adds redacted live history and RPC output proof, then merge through normal checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the chat/message output and RPC contract surfaces touched by this PR.
